name: Winsol Engineers Ltd
tagline: Micro-cap SME balance-of-plant EPC and O&M contractor for wind/solar parks (plus EHV substation civil/electrical) - ~32% ROCE and ~9x earnings, and one Sovrenn-flagged Rs 49.8 Cr EHV order worth ~36% of FY26 revenue, but a low-moat contractor layer with an order book only ~0.5x revenue and decelerating growth
business_overview: Winsol Engineers (incorporated 2015, NSE SME) is an integrated EPC and commissioning company providing Balance of Plant (BoP) solutions for wind and solar power plants - foundations, substation civil and electrical work, right-of-way, cabling to substation/grid - plus O&M services (supervision, inspection, SCADA monitoring) for wind and solar parks. Sovrenn Daily News seed (2026-09-02); Sovrenn trigger: a Rs 49.80 Cr purchase & service order from KPIG Energia for supply + erection/testing/commissioning on a 400 kV EHV transmission line in Gujarat.
fundamentals_table: ~32%; net worth ~Rs 63.9 Cr; small dividend (Rs 1/share) proposed
~Rs 68.8 Cr disclosed (~0.5x FY26 revenue) - thin forward visibility
Rs 49.80 Cr KPIG Energia order (400 kV EHV line, Gujarat) ~= 36% of FY26 revenue in one order; other recent orders small (Rs 3.6 Cr O&M, Rs 8.25 Cr GETCO, Rs 15.4 Cr Hinduja Renewables)
fundamentals_narrative: Financially tidy for an SME - ~32% ROCE, ~9x earnings, ~74% promoter holding, modest net worth, small dividend - and the Sovrenn-flagged Rs 49.8 Cr KPIG Energia EHV order is genuinely large versus a ~Rs 137 Cr revenue base. But renewable BoP EPC and O&M is a commoditised contractor layer with no pricing power, the disclosed order book is only ~0.5x revenue (limited visibility), other recent wins are small, growth has decelerated to ~22% from higher prior rates, and the company is a thinly traded micro-cap SME with lumpy single-order dependence. There is no VP thread.
sentiment_summary: No ValuePickr thread. Assessment is web/filings/news-only: FY26 results (revenue Rs 136.6 Cr / PAT Rs 14.4 Cr, both +22%), the KPIG Energia EHV order, and a series of small solar O&M / transmission-line orders (GETCO, Hinduja Renewables).
bse_notes: No SEBI or fraud action found. Promoter holding ~73.7%. FY26 dividend of Rs 1/share proposed.
bull_case: ~32% ROCE, ~9x earnings, ~74% promoter holding - clean SME financials
Sovrenn-flagged Rs 49.8 Cr KPIG Energia EHV order is ~36% of FY26 revenue in a single win
Riding the renewable-park + transmission build-out; adds O&M annuity-style revenue
FY26 revenue and PAT both +22%; small dividend signals some capital discipline
bear_case: Renewable BoP EPC / O&M is a low-moat, commoditised contractor layer with no pricing power
Disclosed order book only ~Rs 68.8 Cr (~0.5x revenue) - thin forward visibility; other recent orders are small
Growth decelerating to ~22% from higher prior rates
Micro-cap SME (~Rs 130 Cr) with thin liquidity and lumpy single-order dependence
No forum scrutiny; short listed track record
verdict_headline: The Sovrenn-flagged Rs 49.8 Cr EHV order is real and large vs size, but this is a low-moat renewable-BoP contractor with an order book only ~0.5x revenue and decelerating growth. thesis_fit neither, conviction Low.
verdict_reasoning: Sovrenn Daily News seed; the trigger (Rs 49.8 Cr KPIG Energia EHV order) holds up and is material against ~Rs 137 Cr FY26 revenue - so not a no-catalyst filter-out

But the business is a commoditised renewable BoP EPC / O&M contractor with no pricing power; the disclosed order book is only ~0.5x revenue, other recent wins are small, and FY26 growth (+22%) has already decelerated
